messages:
anya: kick-off: we need a concrete playbook for precision overrides that operators and customers can rely on. decision boundaries + safety nets.
mike_k: two main storage choices: model-bundled vs central override store. model-bundled = reproducible across infra, central = fast mitigation.
priya: add to that: model-bundled profiles are immutable per model version. good for audits but painful when a critical fix is needed. central gives last-mile flexibility.
sam: ops perspective: central store requires a strong cache-consistency strategy. nodes should use ETags + conditional GETs to avoid thundering herd. also fallback to pinned-profile bundled in model.
zach: what about profile schema? keep it tiny for edge devices. propose a core section + optional extended section. runtime merges core only when memory constrained.
priya: suggested minimal schema keys: profile_version, allowed_bitpaths (list), quality_thresholds (metric:delta), fallback_order, lite_blob_ref. example inline: `allowed_bitpaths:["fp8","int8","4bit"]`.
anya: fallback_order should reference named model variants, not raw bitwidths, e.g. `fallback_order:["model-vfp8","model-vint8","model-v4bit"]`. keeps runtime deterministic.
sam: telemetry hooks: runtime should emit sample-level signals: deg_score_window, top_k_entropy, token_confidence_p95. these feed the gating controller.
runtime-bot: stub: deg_score_window and top_k_entropy were added to /specs/telemetry/deg-v2 yesterday.
mike_k: security: any central override must be signed by the customer's org key and include an "issued_by" and TTL. record in immutable audit log. ops API requires RBAC.
priya: rollout model: preflight -> dry-run with offline traces -> canary (pct + time window) -> ramp. automated rollback if weighted signal exceeds threshold for a sustained period.
zach: implement weighted signal: score = 0.6 * deg_score_delta + 0.3 * top_k_disagree + 0.1 * perplexity_delta. rollback if score > 0.05 for 10 minutes. (tunable).
anya: need CLI to evict profile cache on a node or group. ops-bot should support `ops-bot evict-profile --node=node-123 --profile=<id>`.
ops-bot: noted. will add RFC for eviction endpoints + safety check `--confirm` flag.
sam: runtime constraint: on small GPUs/NICs we should avoid fetching extended eval promptsets. add `lite_blob_ref` in profile which can be an encoded small representation.
priya: for reproducibility, every override pushed to central store should generate a snapshot artifact (tarball) linked to the model registry so QA can rerun exactly the same.
mike_k: API sketch: GET /v1/profiles/{org}/{model}?if-none-match=ETag returns 200 with profile or 304. POST /v1/overrides/{org}/{model} with signed payload and header X-Signature. Webhook for preflight results.
anya: rollout ops: default to offline sim for any override > 0.5% traffic change or enabling new bitpath. small tweaks can skip offline if below thresholds.
zach: we should also include a "safety_backstop" flag in profile that forces fallback to a safe fully-accurate variant when any telemetry subsystem is unreachable.
priya: test plan: unit tests for merge semantics (central override vs model default vs global default), integration tests for ETag caching, e2e canary with synthetic traffic, regression tests with eval promptsets.
anya: action items: (1) Mike proto for config API + auth (2) Priya define minimal/extended schema + lite-blob format (3) Sam add ETag + eviction + telemetry hooks in runtime (4) Zach draft rollback automation and weighted signal defaults (5) Ops-bot implement eviction CLI. target: draft RFC in 5 days, internal canary next week.
mike_k: will include rate-limit and audit requirements in the proto.
priya: I'll prepare fake traces for two internal customers for the offline sim.
zach: will write the rollback playbook and alert thresholds.
anya: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single source for follow-ups. if anyone adds a new field to schema, call it out here so we can update tests. :white_check_mark:
